name: Fighting Lion

frame.name: Delayed Gratification
frame.description:
Grenade projectiles will bounce off surfaces.
[Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.

perks.name: Countermass
perks.description:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Thin the Herd
perks.description: Direct hits do increased damage to combatant shields and cause a volatile detonation. Dealing damage increases reload speed. Rapid final blows against grenade-damaged combatants refill the magazine.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: "I call it the Zhang Fei. It hits almost as hard as I do." —Wei Ning
